title: Trav B Ryan lights up the scene with emotions on new music video "Red Stars"
htmlContent: Trav B Ryan unveils a gripping yet heartwarming new single and music video, "Red Stars," a blend of deep emotion, sharp storytelling, and an unexpected comic-inspired twist. Recorded at Jambox Studios in New York, NY, "Red Stars" presents Trav B Ryan at his most transparent and artistic. https://youtu.be/E1IZJEQjxBQ Drawing on a deep connection with DC Comics' Red Hood, Trav transforms the character's complex history into one touched by his own experiences and his complicated relationship with dear old dad. The act of creating was as transformative behind the scenes. His sound engineer, who didn't know anything about Red Hood when they started, researched the comics in real time and emerged a full-on fanatic after recording. The unexpected trip is emblematic of "Red Stars," an invitation to a tale that engrosses fans of comics as well as those who are not. The visual storytelling of Trav B Ryan takes the mythology of Red Hood to another level, telling a story of identity, conflict, and emotional honesty that resonates with all walks of life. The best stories are those that come from real human experiences, but are exaggerated. Trav B Ryan is exceeding the boundaries, thanks to the Inshot video editing app that has given him the chance, once again, to create visuals for his singles that repeat and spread far and wide without any barriers getting in the way. In "Red Stars," Trav B Ryan introduces a whole creative world full of sincerity, emotional weight, and layered meaning. Follow Trav B Ryan on Instagram and Facebook
